Hat niemand Wortzeiten für einen Song, h: If nobody has word times for a song, the AI listens wherever it is playing, a new song from its start while it is still being looked up; if the song needs nothing, it drops that at once. If you hear only part of it, it keeps what it heard and hears the rest next time. Once it knows nearly all of it, the song runs word by word. It never writes down livestreams, videos or podcasts: when nobody has the text, it only listens if Deezer or Apple know the song.
